entries.text: You walk so fucking slow, the moss on the sidewalk isn't just racing you—it's actively setting up a gentrified neighborhood around your ankles.
Your jogging pace looks less like cardio and more like you're trying to walk home after completely shitting your pants at a dive bar.
You run so slow, a guy trying to mug you just gave up out of sheer boredom and handed you twenty bucks out of pity.
Your "power walk" speed looks like a zombie that isn't even hungry for brains anymore — it just gave up.
You jog with the exact same frantic, uncoordinated energy of a guy in wet flip-flops trying to outrun the cops.
Your walking pace is so pathetic, the whole neighborhood asked you to speed up because you're ruining the corner's property value.
You jog so slow, your own shadow looks like it's standing there checking its phone and its watch waiting for your slow ass to catch up.
Your running form looks like a drunk flamingo fleeing a fire drill in six-inch platform heels.
Your jog looks like the aggressive waddle of someone trying to hold in a massive diarrhea explosion during a high-stakes job interview.
A snail just passed you on the sidewalk and left a slime trail that clearly spelled out "get a lifestyle change, you weak bitch."
Your push-up depth is so non-existent, you're basically just doing a series of aggressive, sweaty nods to a terrified dust bunny.
You hold a plank for so short, the digital stopwatch didn't even have time to register that you're a weak-ass bitch.
Your core is so weak, you tried to do a sit-up and your stomach flat-out told your brain, "Fuck you, we live down here now."
You do push-ups like you're trying to apologize to the earth for being on it, but the earth is absolutely not accepting your apology.
Your "push-up" is literally just you lying face down in the rug while your ass twitches.
Your upper body strength is so completely fucked, you couldn't push a sleeping cat off your own chest.
You do a plank and your gut sags so low, it's scraping the floorboards like a broken muffler on a '98 Honda Civic.
You shake so hard during planks, the downstairs neighbors think you're going at the drywall with a jackhammer.
You look so pathetic face-down on that rug, your Roomba didn't even try to clean around you — it just aggressively rammed your ribs and gave up.
Your air squat depth is so tragic, it looks like you're hovering over a filthy gas station toilet you refuse to actually touch.
You do lunges like a newborn giraffe that just got tranquilized and forgot which legs were which.
Your jumping jacks look like an uncoordinated mess swatting away invisible hornets in a Denny's parking lot at 4 AM.
Your knees pop so fucking loud during squats, it sounds like two skeletons brawling in a rusty dumpster.
Your "high knees" are so damn low, a corgi couldn't even limbo under your shins.
You did three jump squats and turned a shade of purple usually reserved for a cartoon character holding its breath.
Your lunges are so unstable, your ankles are currently looking for a divorce attorney to get away from your uncoordinated ass.
Your squat form looks like you're trying to hide a stolen laptop between your butt cheeks while fleeing a Best Buy security guard.
You tried doing some shadowboxing in your bedroom and accidentally knocked your own dumb ass out with your reflection's elbow.
Your air movements look less like fitness and more like a drunk uncle butchering the Macarena at a wedding.
You do lunges like you're trying to step over a pile of fresh dog shit, but you keep landing right the fuck in the middle of it.
Your squats are so shallow, your glutes are practically in a long-distance relationship with your hamstrings.
You are so fucking stiff, when you try to touch your toes, your spine makes a sound like a dry branch snapping in half.
Your hamstrings are tighter than a camel's ass in a sandstorm.
You groaned so loud just trying to sit cross-legged, your neighbors called a priest to perform an emergency exorcism in your living room.
Your flexibility is so non-existent, a rusty hinge is looking at you thinking, "Damn, someone get that bitch some WD-40."
You tried to twist your torso and your back popped loud enough to echo through a public restroom.
Your balance is so goddamn terrible, you managed to tip over while sitting flat on your own ass.
Your attempt at a side stretch looks like a rusty garage door that gave up halfway down.
You try to open up your hips and it sounds like an old wooden pirate ship being cracked apart by a pissed-off sea monster.
You're so immobile, your "stretching routine" looks like a cheap display mannequin being shoved into a duffel bag by an impatient mover.
Your joints are so dry, you try to rotate your neck and it sounds like someone aggressively chewing on a handful of unpopped popcorn kernels.
You tried a basic backbend and your spine literally asked your brain what the hell it did to deserve this.
You stretch so terribly that the only thing actually getting elongated is the deep, existential regret of everyone forced to watch you.
Your dog took one look at your sweaty, pathetic ass on the floor, packed his chew toys, and went to find a human with actual dignity.
Your apartment walls are so thin, your neighbor yelled "Give it up, you weak piece of shit!" after your second pathetic push-up.
Your cat is staring at your workout face with so much disgust, she's actively trying to call PETA about what she's being forced to watch.
Your family has a separate group chat without you that's just 400 unread messages of them mercilessly roasting your heavy breathing noises.
Your kids use video clips of your home workouts to blackmail you whenever they want to stay up past their goddamn bedtime.
Your roommates built a literal barricade out of trash and furniture just so they wouldn't have to look at your sweaty, miserable face.
Your heavy breathing is so loud, your smart speaker lit up asking if everything's okay in there.
Your "power walk" is so incredibly pathetic, the local sidewalk ants are actively passing you on the inside track to avoid getting stuck in your traffic jam.
Your upper body strength is so completely shot, trying to push yourself off the carpet looks like a wet cardboard box trying to fight its way out of a soggy paper bag.
Your "sit-up" is literally just your head lifting two inches while your neck veins look like they're about to fucking detonate.
You look so helpless trying to roll over on the rug, a passing housefly could land on your chest and pin your weak ass down for a three-count.
You stayed face-down on the carpet for so long, your smart home system assumed the house was abandoned and shut off the electricity.
You did four bodyweight movements and turned a shade of red that makes your head look like a high-alert warning light at a nuclear test site.
Your spouse walked into the living room, took one look at your miserable form, and silently walked backward out of the house to go buy milk.
The Amazon delivery guy looked through your window while you were struggling on the floor and left a brochure for a local physical therapist on the porch.
You gasp so hard during the warm-up jog, the building's fire alarm thinks there's an active emergency on the third floor.
Your dumbbell bicep curls are so slow, the weight gains consciousness and files a restraining order against your arms.
You do lunges with such terrible balance, the fire department installed a strobe light above you for safety.
Your push-up form is so shallow, you're basically just aggressively saluting a cockroach on the floor.
You rest between sets so long, your gym locker filed a missing person's report on your ass.
Your squat range of motion is so tiny, you look like you're half-committing to sitting on a toilet you don't trust.
You sweat through a five-minute plank so badly, the floor underneath you filed for divorce.
Your resistance band movements are so herky-jerky, it looks like a puppet with cut strings having an existential crisis.
You huff and puff doing jumping jacks, the smoke detector downstairs started screaming for backup.
Your deadlift—I mean bodyweight squat—is so wobbly, structural engineers showed up to assess load-bearing stability.
You grunt lifting a single five-pound dumbbell like you're moving a refrigerator with your teeth.
Your lunges are so uneven, your left leg filed a complaint with your right leg about workplace discrimination.
You do mountain climbers so slowly, an actual snail filed a lawsuit for defamation of pace.
Your burpee recovery is so exhausted, you look like a dying fish trying to remember how to flop.
You hold a plank and shake so hard, the neighbors thought you were brewing illegal methamphetamine.
Your sit-up is so pathetic, your neck is doing all the work while your abs just sit there contemplate their poor life choices.
You take so long between exercises, your water bottle started a meditation practice and achieved enlightenment.
Your form during lunges is so chaotic, a physical therapist just drove by and wept.
You do arm circles with such stiff shoulders, a door hinge called asking for tips on mobility.
Your squat depth is so non-existent, you look like you're practicing for a job interview at a very awkwardly-spaced company.
Your heavy breathing after three push-ups sounds like a 1970s dial-up modem finally connecting to AOL.
You do a plank rotation and your core pops so loud, the superintendent checked for gas leaks.
Your jumping jacks look like an inflatable tube man flailing wildly in a car dealership parking lot.
You do jumping jacks so loudly, the neighbor's light fixture just fell off the fucking ceiling.
You look like you're fighting an invisible octopus during your warm-up routine.
You look like a human glitch in the matrix every time you try to move more than one limb at once.
You tried to do a burpee and launched your coffee mug into the drywall like a fucking wrecking ball.
You've done so much damage to the living room, you're basically a natural disaster with a gym membership.
Your workout has turned the living room into a crime scene of scattered pillows and shattered home decor.
You're making noises so strange, the dog is currently trying to hide in the backyard until you stop your weird-ass routine.
Your breathing sounds like a dying accordion being stepped on by a heavy work boot.
You sweat with the intensity of a melting ice cube in a fucking sauna.
You're doing lunges to the printer, and the only thing you're printing is an HR complaint about your bizarre behavior.
You tried to do desk dips and the chair rolled away, sending your lazy ass straight into the supply closet.
The entire office is having a meeting about how weird your midday stretching session is, and you're not even invited.
You tried to sneak in a quick squat and ripped your trousers so loud the entire accounting department stopped working to stare.
